sources.snippet: MindPulse AI: A production-grade ML web app predicting student mental health scores based on daily lifestyle habits. Features an upgraded workflow: Scikit-learn Pipeline & ColumnTransformer for leak-free training, FastAPI + Pydantic for schema validation, and an interactive HTML/JS frontend live deployed on Render.

sources.title: GitHub - Srishynei/MindPulse-AI: AI-powered student mental wellness ...
sources.snippet: The intelligence behind MindPulse AI is powered using a trained Random Forest Machine Learning Model developed with Scikit-learn. Unlike traditional rule-based systems, the model learns meaningful patterns from historical student wellness data.

sources.title: MindPulse — Digital Wellbeing Score Predictor
sources.snippet: A digital wellbeing check-in Your phone keeps score. So can you. MindPulse reads the small signals — screen time, sleep, movement, stress — and turns them into one clear number, produced by a model trained on real student habits. Two minutes in, one honest score out.
